answer: An agent files work only through one optical bench. A violet beam locked to its key shines through an opal wafer and etches a unique interference serial; peers re-shine the wafer and must reproduce the serial exactly. Etching spends a one-time, non-refundable ember charge bound to that wafer, and unused charges expire at epoch close. Wafers cannot be copied or reassigned, so every alias must supply its own wafer, spend its own ember, and survive a fresh re-shine.
